if: a subsidy is directly linked to the price
it is NOT provided by the Central Government or a State Government
then: the subsidy is INCLUDED in the value of supply, and it is included in the value of supply OF THE SUPPLIER WHO RECEIVES IT
source_section: CGST s.15(2)(e) with the Explanation to s.15(2)
note: Two filters: the subsidy must be directly linked to the price, and Central or State Government subsidies are excluded. The Explanation fixes WHOSE value it enters — the recipient of the subsidy, which need not be the person who benefits from the lower price.

evidence.quote: subsidies directly linked to the price excluding subsidies provided by the Central Government and State Governments.
For the purposes of this sub-section, the amount of subsidy shall be included in the value of supply of the supplier who receives the subsidy.
